empty.title: No chaos results recorded yet
empty.body: Run the scenarios on a machine with Docker and record them, and each result appears here.

disk.title: Disk space guard
disk.description: Free space on the data directory and the Docker volume. Below the critical floor, deploys, pulls and backups are refused before they can fill the disk.
disk.refusing: A volume is below the critical floor. Deploys, image pulls and backups are refused until space is freed.
disk.thresholds: Warns below {{low}} free, refuses risky operations below {{critical}}. Set APP_DISK_LOW_FREE_MB and APP_DISK_CRITICAL_FREE_MB to change this.

cli.summary: Run the scenarios from a terminal instead
cli.note: Needs a CLI built with the chaoslive tag and a local Docker daemon.

benchmarks.title: Benchmarks
benchmarks.description: Results files from bench chaos run, kept with the host and build that produced them so runs can be shown and compared.

standingCaveat.title: Not production capacity numbers
standingCaveat.body: These runs measure a load generator and the control plane on one machine. Unless the host is a Linux server, they are NOT Linux production numbers. Read the caveats of each run before quoting a figure.

empty.title: No benchmark runs stored yet
empty.body: Run the scenarios on a machine with Docker and upload the results file, and each run appears here.

history.title: Run history
history.nonLinux: Some runs are from non-Linux hosts.

compare.title: Compare
compare.head: Head
compare.basis: Each value is the median over that side's runs. A change under {{noise}} percent reads as the same.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this benchmark run?
confirmDelete.body: Run {{id}} is removed for everyone. The results file you uploaded is not affected.
